input: Find STEM, science, coding, academic, cooking and enrichment summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Arden, Fletcher, Skyland, Fairview and Mills River, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Arden Fletcher Mills River summer camps 2026 STEM science coding

candidates.name: Zaniac Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 STEM and math camps at Biltmore Park in South Asheville; also offered sessions at UNC Asheville.

candidates.name: The North Carolina Arboretum
candidates.note: 2026 Discovery Camps offered nature exploration and educational activities at the Arboretum near Bent Creek.

candidates.name: Carolina Day School
candidates.note: August 2026 enrichment camps for rising junior kindergarten through grade 6.

candidates.name: Town of Fletcher Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camp included field trips, nature activities, crafts, sports and swimming.

candidates.name: Asheville Museum of Science
candidates.note: 2025 and 2026 science day camps with experiments, engineering activities and natural-world themes.

candidates.name: Blue Ridge Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Academy offered hands-on learning camps for elementary, middle and high school students.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension, Buncombe County Center
candidates.note: 2026 4-H Summer Fun day camps; youth development programming emphasizes hands-on learning.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension, Henderson County Center
candidates.note: 2026 supervised 4-H summer gardening program included a pumpkin patch for ages 5–8 at Bullington Gardens.

candidates.name: The Educational Garden Project
candidates.note: 2026 garden camp for ages 6–10 and CIT program for ages 11–16 included gardening, cooking and animal care.

candidates.name: The New Classical Academy
candidates.note: Four weeklong 2026 themed camps for rising K4/kindergarten through grade 5, with outdoor time and free play.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer camps included creative, science and general enrichment options; 2027 information scheduled for February 1.

candidates.name: Asheville Community Movement
candidates.note: 2026 Movers and Shakers summer camp used weekly themes focused on community spirit and sustainable living.
